name: Exp_VortexIndicator
summary: This EA trades based on the Vortex Indicator crossover signals, opening buy positions when the VI+ line crosses above the VI- line and sell positions when the VI- line crosses above the VI+ line. It uses configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels, and restricts trade execution to new bar formation on a specified timeframe.
summary_zh: 该EA基于涡旋指标(Vortex Indicator)的交叉信号进行交易，当VI+上穿VI-时开多仓，当VI-上穿VI+时开空仓。它支持可配置的资金管理、止损止盈，并限制仅在指定时间周期的新K线形成时执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是涡旋指标交叉趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为：当VI+线从下方穿越VI-线时产生买入信号，当VI-线从下方穿越VI+线时产生卖出信号，信号通过比较当前K线和前一根K线的VI+/VI-值大小关系来确认交叉。出场条件包括固定的止损和止盈点数设置，以及反向交叉信号触发平仓（多头在卖出信号出现时平仓，空头在买入信号出现时平仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部包含文件TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数实现。策略只在指定时间周期的新K线形成时检测信号，避免同一根K线内重复交易，SignalBar参数允许使用已确认的K线来获取信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a Vortex Indicator crossover trend-following system. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when the VI+ line crosses above the VI- line, and a sell signal is generated when the VI- line crosses above the VI+ line, with crossover confirmation obtained by comparing the relative positions of VI+/VI- values on the current and previous bars. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit settings in points, as well as reverse signal closes — long positions are closed when a sell signal appears and short positions are closed when a buy signal appears. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing. Money management relies on external functions BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen from the included TradeAlgorithms.mqh file. The strategy only checks for signals on new bar formation of the specified timeframe, preventing repeated trades within the same bar, and the SignalBar parameter allows using a confirmed bar for signal retrieval.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，负值为固定手数，正值为存款比例
parameters.description_en: Deposit fraction or lot size; negative=fixed lot

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用新K线检测机制避免同根K线内重复交易，减少过度交易风险
提供完整的买卖开关控制，可灵活控制开仓和平仓方向
涡旋指标交叉策略逻辑清晰，适合趋势行情捕捉
止损止盈参数可配置，具备基本风险控制框架
使用已确认K线(SignalBar=1)获取信号，减少假信号
pros_en: New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Complete buy/sell permission switches provide flexible control over entry and exit directions
Vortex Indicator crossover strategy has clear logic and is suitable for trending market capture
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
Using a confirmed bar (SignalBar=1) for signal retrieval reduces false signals
cons: 缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能频繁触发虚假信号造成损失
依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh文件，核心交易逻辑不可见，难以审计风险
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，可能不适合所有品种和波动环境
没有持仓时间限制或追踪止损机制，趋势反转时可能回吐大量利润
OnInit返回0而非INIT_SUCCEEDED，不符合MQ5标准规范
cons_en: No spread filter, which may cause frequent false signal triggers and losses in high-spread environments
Depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh file with invisible core trading logic, making risk auditing difficult
Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large and may not suit all instruments and volatility conditions
No position time limit or trailing stop mechanism, potentially giving back significant profits on trend reversals
OnInit returns 0 instead of INIT_SUCCEEDED, which does not conform to MQ5 standard conventions
improvements: 增加点差过滤和波动率过滤，避免在不利于交易的市场条件下开仓
添加追踪止损功能，在趋势延续时锁定利润而非仅依赖固定止盈
将MM参数拆分为独立的模式选择和数值参数，提高可读性和安全性
improvements_en: Add spread filter and volatility filter to avoid opening positions in unfavorable market conditions
Implement a trailing stop feature to lock in profits during trend continuation rather than relying solely on fixed take profit
Split the MM parameter into separate mode selection and value parameters for improved readability and safety

risk_points: 核心交易逻辑封装在不可见的外部文件中，无法完整评估资金管理和仓位控制的安全性
缺少点差过滤和最大持仓检查，在极端市场条件下可能产生意外亏损
固定的止损止盈点数不考虑市场波动率变化，在不同品种上可能风险不匹配
risk_points_en: Core trading logic is encapsulated in an invisible external file, making it impossible to fully evaluate the safety of money management and position control
Lack of spread filter and maximum position checks may cause unexpected losses under extreme market conditions
Fixed stop loss and take profit in points does not account for market volatility changes, potentially causing risk mismatch across different instruments

It uses configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels, and restricts trade execution to new bar formation on a specified timeframe.
